subject: Media Literacy
title: Building a Balanced News Diet
description: A 60-second lesson on Building a Balanced News Diet.

hook.text: If you only eat candy, your body suffers. If you only read one news source, your mind does too.

buildup.text: A balanced news diet includes multiple sources with different perspectives, formats, and ownership.

discovery.text: Mix national with local, print with audio, mainstream with independent. Diversity of source builds accuracy.

twist.text: Most people read fewer than three news sources. Their worldview is shaped by a narrow slice of reality.

climax.text: You don't need to read everything. You need to read enough different things to spot the gaps.

punchline.text: One source gives you a story. Multiple sources give you the truth.

quiz.question: What is a balanced news diet?
options: Reading only one trusted source thoroughly
Consuming multiple sources with different perspectives and formats
